answer: Farming becomes a juniper bet on surviving 119 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the copper schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 119 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
